messages:
maria: seeing a weird spike in structured-output rejects on the console (route=toolcall-prod, last 10m). lots of requests falling back to degen-route and increasing quota churn. anyone else? :eyes:
jonathan: yep saw that alert too. console trace shows a sudden jump in `validation.rejects` from 0.2% -> 6.8%. sample ids look like invoke ids from a single SDK client.
sre-bot: ALERT: validation.rejects > 5% for route toolcall-prod (window=10m). top error: 'expected object, got array' (sample=72). Pager: configured.
ana: can we get a minimal failing example? might be a client change sending arrays for tool results.
maria: pasted one sample below (redacted):
```json
{"invoke_id":"inv-7a9f","tool_name":"search","result":[{"title":"X"},{"title":"Y"}]}
```
jonathan: ah — runtime schema expects `result` to be an object with fields `{items: [...], meta: {...}}`. arrays slip through for some legacy clients.
nana: that explains shape mismatch. why did routing go to degen-route though? should have stayed on primary model and returned structured reject, not reroute.
maria: output-shape-rejects trigger a policy we recently merged: when structured validation fails and soft-fallbacks enabled, we route to cheaper degen variant to keep latency / success rate. it looks like that policy flipped on in the rollout yesterday.
devex: ugh that rollout toggle was supposed to be a gradual canary. did the console show rollout %?
jonathan: rollout flag shows 100% for the production toggle due to a config merge conflict. my bad — I merged the flag without the canary range.
nana: OK. immediate mitigation: disable the soft-fallback toggle (flip to strict validate) and bulk-accept rejects that are safe to surface, or add a coercion adapter for arrays -> {items: array}.
oliver: +1 to disabling the toggle. but we should also add a dashboard tile that links the top failing client versions and a quick-action to mark a client as 'legacy-coerce' in routing policy.
maria: putting a short action plan below: 1) jonathan flip rollback -> toggle off (in infra-ui) 2) devex create a small console CTA to replay / mutate sample to verify 3) ana add coercion shim in adapter for the next patch 4) SRE confirm no billing leak from degen route.
jonathan: rolling back now. will post when done.
sre-bot: NOTE: rolling back rollout toggle requested by jonathan. ETA ~30s.
jonathan: rollback complete. validation.rejects back to 0.4% in 2m. routing to degen dropped. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks. follow-ups: add a canary gating rule that prevents full rollout if validation.rejects > 1% in first 30m, and add an ops runbook entry for rating quota impacts when soft-fallbacks activate.
devex: I'll mock a tiny repro kit for SDK teams and add a link in the console. quick question: do we want to auto-coerce arrays globally or only per-client?
nana: start per-client. global coercion hides client bugs. we'll make adapter opt-in with telemetry tag.
oliver: logging note — include the pre-coercion payload in the trace for 30d retention so we can debug new cases.
maria: OK capturing action owners: jonathan (rollback + gating rule), ana (coercion shim PR), devex (repro kit + console CTA), oliver (trace retention), maria (ops runbook). I'll open a short incident ticket and link this thread. :locket_heart:
jonathan: ticket created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026 (summary + next steps).
